dose.def: The amount of a substance that enters an organism, usually given in milligrams per kilogram of body mass (mg/kg) so animals of different sizes can be compared.

toxicity.def: How harmful a substance is to living things. A toxicant is a substance that causes harm; the smaller the dose needed to cause harm, the higher the toxicity.

ld50.def: Lethal dose 50%: the dose, in mg per kg of body mass, that kills half of a test population. A lower LD50 means a more toxic substance.
